description.ja: 「ソードアート・オンライン」からメインヒロインの「アスナ」が登場！
description.en: The main heroine "Asuna " from " Sword Art Online" appears!

description.ja: • 髪の毛の一部を新素材で成形。パーツ分割により可動する髪の毛はポージングを阻害しない設計になっている。
description.en: • Part of the hair is molded with new material. The hair is movable due to its separate parts and is designed to not interfere with posing.

description.ja: • 太もも部分はパーツの内側に赤みの強いパーツをはめる二層構造で、自然な肌の質感を追求。
description.en: • The thigh part has a two-layer structure with a reddish part placed on the inside of the part, pursuing a natural skin texture.

description.ja: • 伸ばす、ひねる、曲げるなど、実際の人体のような関節ギミックにより自然な動きを再現可能。
description.en: • Natural movements such as stretching, twisting, and bending can be reproduced using joint gimmicks similar to those of the actual human body.

description.ja: • 「通常顔」に加え「叫び顔」「怒り顔」の３種類が付属。ポージングに合わせた表情を楽しめる。
description.en: • In addition to the "normal face ", three types are included: " screaming face " and " angry face". You can enjoy the expressions that match the poses.

description.ja: • 抜刀・納刀を一部パーツの差し替えで表現。ハンドパーツは右手３種、左手２種の計５種が付属。
description.en: • The drawing and sheathing of the sword is expressed by replacing some parts. A total of 5 types of hand parts are included, 3 types for the right hand and 2 types for the left hand.

accessories.ja: ハンドパーツ右手×3種、左手×2種
accessories.en: Hand parts: Right hand x 3 types, left hand x 2 types
